{{Quote|He's asking to evacuate the building.|Console worker to Supervisor Lagret|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
'''A [[human]]''' with light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] worked for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] in [[2 BBY]]. While on hold,<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> she<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion AD" /> covered the [[microphone]] on her [[headset]] as she reported a request to evacuate the [[Imperial Senate Building]] to [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Lagret]]. Supervisor Lagret angrily responded with an order to seal up and lock down the building instead. The worker wore a light gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with two blue pips on her [[rank insignia plaque]] and a black [[Imperial kepi]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The worker appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Credited simply as "console #1", she was portrayed by [[Hayley Osborne]] in the episode.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
